scripts.dev:all: pnpm exec convex dev --once && pnpm dev
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n convex,vite -c blue,green "pnpm exec convex dev" "pnpm dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @arcadeclub/core --filter @arcadeclub/chess --filter @arcadeclub/mobile run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/env.mjs exec dev --only github -- pnpm run ship:dev
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/env.mjs exec staging --only github -- pnpm run ship:staging
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/env.mjs exec production --only github -- pnpm run ship:production
scripts.ship:dev: CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY= CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN= CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT=dev:zany-parakeet-507 node scripts/keep-env-local.mjs -- pnpm exec convex dev --once && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev pnpm run build:development && wrangler deploy
scripts.ship:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging convex deploy --cmd-url-env-var-name CONVEX_URL --cmd 'VITE_CONVEX_URL=$CONVEX_URL VITE_SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=staging pnpm build' && wrangler deploy
scripts.ship:production: convex deploy --cmd-url-env-var-name CONVEX_URL --cmd 'VITE_CONVEX_URL=$CONVEX_URL pnpm build' && wrangler deploy
scripts.mobile:update:preview: node scripts/env.mjs exec staging --only eas -- node apps/mobile/scripts/publish-update.mjs preview
scripts.mobile:update:production: node scripts/env.mjs exec production --only eas -- node apps/mobile/scripts/publish-update.mjs production
